decisions.reason: After remaining in the portfolio for several years, this multi-model garage door operator line appears to have cleared the main uncertainty phase and is a core complement to the firm's garage door business, so management would likely keep it.

This insulated glazed industrial sectional door fits the firm's industrial, compliance and performance-oriented offering well, and after surviving the initial trial period it is more likely to be retained than abandoned, though its narrower niche keeps some withdrawal risk.
